description: This file defines the BrowserStoreClass which manages browser storage interactions such as login/logout signaling, landing page preferences, and notification banners for the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: BrowserStoreClass
classes.description: Manages browser storage interactions including login/logout signaling, landing page preferences, and notification banners.

methods.name: signalLogout
methods.description: Signals a logout event by storing an identifier in session and local storage, and removing previous logout indicators.

methods.name: isSignallingLogout
methods.description: Checks if a given logout ID matches the current session storage logout indicator.

methods.name: signalLogin
methods.description: Signals a login event by storing an identifier in session and local storage.

methods.name: isSignallingLogin
methods.description: Checks if a given login ID matches the current session storage login indicator.

methods.name: isLocalStorageSupported
methods.description: Checks if local storage and session storage are supported and usable in the current browser environment.

methods.name: hasSeenLandingPage
methods.description: Returns whether the landing page has been seen, based on local storage.

methods.name: setLandingPageSeen
methods.description: Marks the landing page as seen in local storage.

methods.name: getLandingPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the landing preference for a given site URL.

methods.name: setLandingPreferenceToMattermostApp
methods.description: Sets the landing preference to Mattermost app for a given site URL.

methods.name: setLandingPreferenceToBrowser
methods.description: Sets the landing preference to browser for a given site URL.

methods.name: clearLandingPreference
methods.description: Removes the landing preference for a given site URL.

methods.name: getHideNotificationPermissionRequestBanner
methods.description: Checks if the notification permission request banner should be hidden.

methods.name: setHideNotificationPermissionRequestBanner
methods.description: Sets the flag to hide the notification permission request banner.

methods.name: clearHideNotificationPermissionRequestBanner
methods.description: Clears the flag to hide the notification permission request banner.
